announcements.title: Muxaadaro
announcements.content:
Waxaa casharro taxane ah inoogu soo jeedin doona Sheekh Cabdiraxmaan, muxaadarooyin waxay ku saabsan yihiin guurka. Maanto oo Isniin ah waxaa jiri doonta muxaadaro salaadda Casarka ka dib. 

Maalin walba oo Axad ah bacda casar ayay hadda ka dib uu noo socon doonaa insha Allah.

announcements.title: A kind reminder
announcements.content: Please leave the Masjid quietly, do not congregate or gather outside, and be mindful of our neighbours

announcements.title: Announcement
announcements.content:
Please note that from 18 May 2026 to 27 July 2026, Fajr prayer will not be held at the mosque. This is due to our current premises licence, which only permits opening hours between 04:00 and 23:00, while Fajr prayer during this period falls outside of these permitted hours.

We kindly advise all attendees to perform Fajr prayer at Baitul Aman Mosque during this time.
